items.comments: Amy was able to accommodate us at a moment notice. The location an amazing sunset view. My wife and I loved looking out the window as we were getting ready to go out in the middle of downtown Seattle. The welcome was like a home and the quality was like a highly rated hotel.

Check in was easy and convenient. Upon check in I was greeted by a property representative  who showed me around the property and answered questions. The property was as described and clean. It is in great location. I would definitely reserve this property again.
